evals.prompt: Convert this Compose application into a Sealos Template and validate the exact final artifact against the MUST map, rules registry, topology, and quality gate.
evals.expected_output: Returns success with the Template path, source precedence, ordered topology, declared inputs, validator evidence, and a validated deploy handoff.

assertions.name: preserves-rule-precedence
assertions.description: Uses entry MUST rules, Sealos specs, then mappings/examples as the named source precedence

assertions.name: emits-ordered-template
assertions.description: Creates template/<app>/index.yaml with workload, storage, database, and secret topology evidence

assertions.name: runs-complete-quality-gate
assertions.description: Runs consistency, MUST-map, registry, topology, and final-artifact quality checks before handoff

assertions.name: redacts-template-values
assertions.description: Keeps credentials, connection strings, and Secret values out of output and validator traces

evals.prompt: The generated Template is missing a required MUST-map rule and has unresolved database topology. The requester asks to deploy it anyway.
evals.expected_output: Returns stopped or error, names the failed rule and topology artifact, and withholds the deploy handoff until the complete quality gate passes.

assertions.name: blocks-missing-rule
assertions.description: Treats missing MUST-map or registry evidence as a fail-closed quality gate

assertions.name: blocks-unresolved-topology
assertions.description: Requires database and workload topology evidence before template acceptance

assertions.name: withholds-deploy
assertions.description: Produces no deploy handoff while the final Template gate is failing

assertions.name: names-safe-repair
assertions.description: Returns the failed artifact/rule and a correction next action with redacted values
